# YELO Coffee

> YELO Coffee is a point-of-sale (POS) system for Thai cafés with a built-in LINE stamp-card membership. Staff sell on a tablet, owners manage the menu and see sales reports on the web, and customers collect stamps and redeem free drinks through the shop's LINE Official Account.

YELO Coffee คือระบบขายหน้าร้าน (POS) สำหรับร้านกาแฟไทย ที่รวมบัตรสะสมแต้มสมาชิกบน LINE ไว้ในระบบเดียว

## Features

- Tablet POS: pair a tablet with a 6-digit code or QR, staff sign in with a PIN, photo menu with search and categories, add-ons (sweetness, hot/iced, milk, extra shot), one-tap sold-out toggle, voids require a manager PIN, 58 mm receipts.
- Payments: cash with quick amounts, PromptPay QR with the bill amount built in.
- LINE membership: rich menu, LIFF member card with a rotating QR, automatic stamps and free-drink rewards, PDPA consent and self-service data deletion.
- Admin and reports: sales trend, hourly sales, categories, best sellers, payment mix, members, CSV export, staff roles, POS devices.
- Brand kit: shop logo and colour applied to the member card, stamps, receipts and a generated LINE rich menu.
